# Moroccan Beauty Wholesale

> Ready-to-sell Moroccan beauty products for shops, spas and hotels: argan oil, black soap, ghassoul clay, rose water, kessa gloves and hammam kits. Minimum order: 50 pieces. We reply within 24 hours on business days. Factory in Agadir, Morocco. Office: Lot 377 N°3/6, Sidi Ghanem industrial zone, 40110 Marrakesh, Morocco. Contact: orders@moroccanbeautywholesale.com. Languages: English, French, Arabic.
